Study (design, country): Bakkour 2016; retrospective audit or cohort at a tertiary psoriasis clinic; United Kingdom
Population (total N; psoriasis n; PsA n;: 42 patients, 77 procedures; psoriasis 28 patients (54 procedures); PsA 14 patients (23 procedures); no other diagnoses
Surgery: Mixed; orthopaedic 15 of 77 (19.5%), of which 9 continued and 6 stopped; remainder minor or dermatologic
Comparison and agents: Continue (57 procedures) versus stop (20 procedures), design level; etanercept, adalimumab, infliximab, ustekinumab, golimumab; single class not isolable
Outcomes: Infection or delayed wound healing, perioperative; physician-observed psoriasis or PsA flare
Directness and contribution: Direct. Primary comparative pool for infection or wound complications (MA1) and comparative disease-flare pool (MA2), plus single-arm proportions

Study (design, country): Fabiano 2014; retrospective multicenter cohort or case series; Italy
Population (total N; psoriasis n; PsA n;: 131 patients; psoriasis 131; PsA 0; no other diagnoses
Surgery: 58 major procedures (including orthopaedic) and 73 minor procedures; no orthopaedic-only denominator; orthopaedic signal is 2 knee arthroplasty wound infections
Comparison and agents: Continue (87 patients) versus discontinue (44 patients) under British Association of Dermatologists guidance, design level; infliximab, adalimumab, etanercept, ustekinumab
Directness and contribution: Direct. Primary comparative pool for infection or wound complications (MA1) and continuer proportion

Study (design, country): Day 2023; retrospective case-control administrative database (PearlDiver), 1:4 matched; United States
Population (total N; psoriasis n; PsA n;: 2,262 patients with psoriasis matched to 9,044 without psoriasis; psoriasis 2,262; PsA not enumerated; comparator is matched patients without psoriasis
Surgery: Single-level lumbar laminotomy or discectomy (spine); 2,262 of 2,262 (100%)
Comparison and agents: Recommendation level: a standing medication-regimen category, with perioperative hold not determinable; topical therapy plus biologics subgroup n = 140; class not reported
Outcomes: Surgical-site infection within 90 days, plus 5-year reoperation
Psoriasis or PsA outcomes separable: No (PsA not identified; exposure chronic, not perioperative)

Population (total N; psoriasis n; PsA n;: 4 patients with psoriasis receiving a TNF inhibitor (1 psoriasis vulgaris, the orthopaedic Case 1; 3 generalized pustular psoriasis); psoriasis 4; PsA 0; no other diagnoses
Surgery: Case 1 Achilles tendon repair (orthopaedic); Cases 2 to 4 non-orthopaedic; orthopaedic 1 of 4
Comparison and agents: Discontinued under Japanese Dermatological Association 2013 guidance; infliximab (Case 1) and adalimumab (other cases), with or without methotrexate; 0 continued and 1 discontinued among orthopaedic cases
Outcomes: Delayed wound healing and cutaneous flare in the orthopaedic case
Directness and contribution: Case level. Narrative only, not pooled

Population (total N; psoriasis n; PsA n;: 1 patient with PsA and coexisting knee osteoarthritis (DAPSA 7.24, low activity); psoriasis 0; PsA 1
Surgery: Bilateral closed-wedge high tibial osteotomy plus staged implant removals (4 procedures over about 2 years); 1 of 1
Comparison and agents: Continued, with adalimumab held for 2 weeks before surgery, a single dosing interval and a short guideline-concordant hold [a]; adalimumab 40 mg every 2 weeks
Outcomes: Wound infection or psoriatic disease flare over 2 years
Directness and contribution: Case level. Narrative only, not pooled

Study (design, country): Kunimi 2018; case report or letter (n = 1); Japan
Population (total N; psoriasis n; PsA n;: 1 patient with psoriatic arthritis mutilans; psoriasis 0; PsA 1
Surgery: Hand surgery (thumb joint fusion plus finger contracture release); 1 of 1
Comparison and agents: Continued during regular infliximab treatment; infliximab 5 mg/kg plus methotrexate
Outcomes: Postoperative infection or recurrence of joint symptoms
Directness and contribution: Case level. Narrative only, not pooled

Study (design, country): Berthold 2013; retrospective single-center cohort, policy-era comparison; Sweden
Population (total N; psoriasis n; PsA n;: 892 patients, 1,596 procedures, of which 1,553 procedures entered the infection analysis; psoriasis not separately enumerated; PsA 32 (4%) in the discontinuation era and 35 (5%) in the continuation era; rheumatoid arthritis about 66% to 67%, spondyloarthritis or ankylosing spondylitis 4%, juvenile idiopathic arthritis 2% to 3%, osteoarthritis 2% to 3%
Surgery: Elective orthopaedic and hand surgery (foot, hand, arthroplasty, other); whole cohort orthopaedic
Comparison and agents: Design-level policy era: continue (681 procedures) versus discontinue (872 procedures); TNF inhibitors (infliximab, etanercept, adalimumab)
Outcomes: Surgical-site infection by the CDC 1992 definition, superficial and deep, with a 1-year window for implant procedures; follow-up mean 5.3 months
Directness and contribution: Direct. Primary comparative pool for infection or wound complications (MA1, 1,553 procedures) and continuer proportion; pooled at whole-cohort level

Study (design, country): Nguyen 2021; retrospective cross-sectional cohort at 2 tertiary hospitals; United States
Population (total N; psoriasis n; PsA n;: 180 patients, 218 procedures (surgical subgroup of 827 biologic users); psoriasis 45 of the 218 surgical procedures (13 stopped, 32 continued) and 27.2% of the 827-patient biologic cohort [b]; PsA 32 of the 218 surgical procedures (12 stopped, 20 continued); inflammatory bowel disease predominant, Crohn disease largest at 38.6% of 827, also ulcerative colitis, rheumatoid arthritis, hidradenitis suppurativa
Surgery: Mixed; orthopaedic 62 of 218 (28.4%): joint replacement 43, open reduction and internal fixation 10 (urgent), tendon 9
Comparison and agents: Design-level held (76 procedures) versus continued (142 procedures); adalimumab, infliximab, etanercept, ustekinumab
Outcomes: Skin or soft-tissue infection within 90 days requiring antibiotics; periprosthetic joint infection among the 43 joint-replacement procedures
Directness and contribution: Direct. Primary comparative pool for infection or wound complications (MA1, 218 procedures) and PJI proportion; pooled at whole-cohort level

Study (design, country): George 2017; retrospective Medicare claims cohort with propensity score and inverse-probability-of-treatment weighting; United States
Population (total N; psoriasis n; PsA n;: 3,867 patients, 4,288 surgeries, all infliximab users; psoriasis, PsA and ankylosing spondylitis combined 562 (13%), with PsA not isolated; rheumatoid arthritis 3,385 (79%), inflammatory bowel disease 475 (11%)
Surgery: Elective primary or revision total hip or knee arthroplasty; 4,288 of 4,288 (100%)
Comparison and agents: Infliximab stop-timing bins. The within-4-weeks bin (1,162 surgeries) is treated as a continuer proxy; the 8-to-12-week reference arm (747 surgeries) does not enter any pool [c]; infliximab only
Outcomes: Hospitalized serious infection within 30 days, which is not surgical-site-infection specific; periprosthetic joint infection within 1 year
Directness and contribution: Timing-proxy (indirect). Continuer proportion for infection or wound complications (1,162 surgeries) and PJI proportion; whole-cohort level

Study (design, country): Di Martino 2023; registry-based retrospective cohort (RIPO) with a propensity-matched osteoarthritis comparator; Italy
Population (total N; psoriasis n; PsA n;: 121 patients on perioperative TNF inhibitor therapy (Cohort A), with comparators of 870 patients on no bDMARD or tsDMARD and 473 with primary osteoarthritis; psoriasis not separately enumerated; PsA 36 (29.8%); rheumatoid arthritis 52.9%, ankylosing spondylitis 17.4%
Comparison and agents: Perioperative TNF inhibitor use (at least 1 prescription in the 6 months before and after surgery) versus no bDMARD or tsDMARD versus osteoarthritis; no discontinuation arm; etanercept 45.5%, adalimumab 35.5%, infliximab 7.4%, certolizumab 7.4%, golimumab 4.1%
Outcomes: Surgical revision of any component and 5-year Kaplan-Meier implant survival; follow-up mean 5 years
Directness and contribution: Contextual (indirect). Narrative implant-survival evidence, not pooled

Study (design, country): Vasavada 2023; retrospective propensity-matched cohort in arthroscopy and sports medicine; United States
Population (total N; psoriasis n; PsA n;: 428 patients, of whom 214 were on baseline immunosuppression (110 stayed on, 104 held) and 214 were not; no cutaneous psoriasis reported; PsA 119 of the 428-patient matched cohort and about 50 within the 214 immunosuppression arms (19% to 28%) [d]; seropositive and seronegative rheumatoid arthritis, sarcoidosis, systemic lupus erythematosus, ankylosing spondylitis, polymyalgia rheumatica
Comparison and agents: Stayed on versus held; aggregate immunosuppression (biologics, csDMARDs, JAK inhibitors, glucocorticoids), of which biologics were 31% of the held arm; the biologic effect is not isolable
Directness and contribution: Direct contrast but aggregate exposure. Comparative disease-flare pool (MA2, 214 patients) and flare proportions; whole-cohort level

Study (design, country): Borgas 2020; retrospective single-arm cohort from a continue-only era; Sweden
Population (total N; psoriasis n; PsA n;: 395 patients, 494 primary elective procedures (total knee arthroplasty 254, total hip arthroplasty 240); psoriasis not separately enumerated; PsA 35 (7%); rheumatoid arthritis 341 (69%), spondyloarthritis or ankylosing spondylitis 29 (5.9%), juvenile idiopathic arthritis 59 (11.9%), other 30 (6.1%)
Surgery: Primary elective total knee and total hip arthroplasty; 494 of 494 (100%)
Comparison and agents: Continue-only cohort comparing TNF inhibitor users with nonusers; TNF inhibitor 157 of 494 (32%): etanercept 93, adalimumab 32, certolizumab 12, infliximab 15, golimumab 5; no discontinuation arm
Outcomes: Periprosthetic joint infection, defined as deep incisional plus organ or space surgical-site infection within 1 year (modified CDC)
Psoriasis or PsA outcomes separable: Partial (PsA-specific PJI 1 of 35 and SSI 2 of 35 reported)
Directness and contribution: Contextual (indirect). PJI proportion (TNF inhibitor arm, 157 patients); whole-cohort level
